rows.evidence: Description prose, as given in the enrichment diff
rows.proposed_value: Example value from the store description

note: Fill approved_by with your name, and fill the session object. Set submitted true for each group you decide. In the 95 percent or better group, list rejections only. Rows not rejected are approved. In the 80 to 94 and 50 to 79 groups, list each row you approve. Rows not listed are not approved. A group that is not submitted gives no approval. Corrections go in corrections, with corrected_value. Additions go in additions, for a held row only, with added_value from the merchant. Questions go in questions, with product_id, field, and question. A row with an open question is held. Close a question in close_questions, with its question_id, then decide the row.

session.note: Fill this from your merchant session. A typed name alone is not authority. The session store ID must match the packet store ID. The session merchant ID must match the packet merchant ID when the packet has one. An expired or revoked session is rejected. A session submitted by an agent is rejected. No signature is verified yet, because no platform issuer or key is supplied yet.
